landing.metaTitle: Your family's recipes in one place
landing.metaDescription: A free, open-source cookbook for your family's recipes – with portion scaling, cook mode, shopping list and meal plan.
landing.tagline: Free · open source · works on your phone
landing.heroTitle: Your family's recipes, finally in one place.
landing.heroText: Stop digging through handwritten cards, screenshots and old notebooks. Collect your favourite recipes, cook with them step by step and share them with the people you love.

features.title: Cookbooks & collections
features.text: All your recipes in one main cookbook, plus collections like “Christmas” or “Quick weeknights”.

features.title: Portion scaling
features.text: Cooking for six instead of four? Every ingredient adjusts automatically.

features.title: Cook mode
features.text: Big step-by-step view that keeps your screen on, with built-in timers.

features.title: Shopping list
features.text: Add a recipe's ingredients with one tap – personal or shared with your family.

features.title: Meal plan
features.text: Plan the week ahead and know what's for dinner.

features.title: Search by ingredient
features.text: Got leftover zucchini? Find every recipe that uses it.

features.title: Print & share
features.text: Print a single recipe or your whole cookbook, or share a recipe card.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Install it on your phone like an app – recipes stay available without internet.

landing.familyText: Invite your family into a shared cookbook. Everyone adds their own recipes, leaves notes and keeps the stories behind each dish – like who brought it to the table first.
familyPoints: Notes and tips on every recipe
Photos and stories behind a dish
landing.aiText: Take a photo of a handwritten card or a cookbook page and the recipe fills itself in.
landing.ctaText: Free to use. No ads. Your recipes stay yours.
